rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when developing or explaining something in detail.

example.english: Could you elaborate on how this plan works?
example.traditional: 你可唔可以詳細講解下呢個方案點樣運作？
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 coeng4 sai3 gong2 gaai2 haa6 ni1 go3 fong1 on3 dim2 joeng2 wan6 zok3

rows.note: Use this casual expression when asking or inviting someone to say more about a point.

example.english: This part is interesting; can you elaborate a bit more?
example.traditional: 呢部分幾有趣，你可唔可以講多啲？
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 fan6 gei2 jau5 ceoi3 nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 do1 di1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something has many complicated or intricately arranged parts.

example.english: The internal structure of this machine is so elaborate that it cannot be explained in just a few words.
example.traditional: 呢部機嘅內部結構好複雜，唔係一兩句講得明。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 gei1 ge3 noi6 bou6 git3 kau3 hou2 fuk1 zaap6 m4 hai6 jat1 loeng5 geoi3 gong2 dak1 ming4

rows.note: Choose this over 複雜 for descriptions, explanations, or information that contain a lot of detail.

example.english: The report gives an elaborate explanation, covering every step clearly.
example.traditional: 份報告寫得好詳細，連每個步驟都交代清楚。
example.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 coeng4 sai3 lin4 mui5 go3 bou6 zaau6 dou1 gaau1 doi6 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this for a visibly fancy, flashy, or showy design, especially when the embellishment feels unnecessary.

example.english: The cake’s decoration is too elaborate, so you can barely see its original shape.
example.traditional: 個蛋糕裝飾太花巧，反而睇唔出原本個樣。
example.jyutping: go3 daan6 gou1 zong1 sik1 taai3 faa1 haau2 faan2 ji4 tai2 m4 ceot1 jyun4 bun2 go3 joeng2
